# Profilestep — Design Notes

## Visual design (from screenshot analysis)

Photographic background: a person lying among dried autumn leaves with
blue grape hyacinth flowers. A white card sits centered on top. Clean,
minimalist onboarding aesthetic. The contrast between the organic
background and the geometric card creates visual interest.

## Section-by-section fidelity notes

### Wrapper / Background
- Full-screen background image, `background-size: cover`, centered
- On mobile (< 768px): background image removed, plain white
- Outer wrapper: 819px max-width, 7px padding, subtle repeating pattern bg
- Inner wizard card: white background, padding 64px top/bottom 58px sides

### Step Indicator
- Positioned absolute, top-right inside the card
- Large number (40px) showing current step, light grey (#ccc)
- Suffix "/ 3" in smaller text (15px)
- Uses CSS pseudo-elements (:before / :after) in original;
  React version: use state-driven span

### Step 1: User Profile
- Heading "USER PROFILE" — uppercase, Poppins SemiBold 35px,
  color #3377c0, letter-spacing 3px, centered
- 2-column form grid with 40px gap between columns
- 6 fields arranged as:
  ```
  Left          Right
  Full Name     Education Level
  Email ID      Phone Number
  Specialization Date of Birth
  ```
- Each field: label (#333, 14px) above input
- Input: 42px height, 1px solid #ccc border, Poppins Medium 15px,
  left padding 46px for icon
- Icons: Material Design Iconic Font in original → lucide-react in React
- Date of Birth: datepicker with format "dd - mm - yyyy"

### Step 2: Residential Address
- Same heading style: "RESIDENTIAL ADDRESS"
- Same 2-column grid layout
- Fields:
  ```
  Left          Right
  Country       Street Address
  Apartment     Town / City
  County        Postcode / Zip
  ```
- Country: custom-styled select (removes native appearance, chevron-down icon)
- Postcode / Zip: password input type with eye toggle (from original HTML)

### Step 3: Category Grid
- Heading: "WHAT ARE YOU DOING?" (slightly smaller margin-bottom: 37px)
- 3-column flex grid, items 31.25% width, 21px bottom margin
- Each card: 86% image thumbnail + 14% vertical label strip
- Label: uppercase, 11px, Poppins Medium, writing-mode: tb-rl,
  transform: rotate(-180deg) for top-to-bottom reading
- Inactive label: background #b3b3b3, white text
- Active label: background #3377c0, white text
- Hover: image opacity 0.6
- Click toggles active state
- Categories: Programming, Sports, Business, Tour Guide, Art-Design, Doctor
- Use picsum.photos placeholder images

### Navigation (generated by jQuery Steps plugin in original)
- Previous / Next in a flex row, space-between, margin-top 42px
- Next: filled button — bg #3377c0, white text, uppercase, letter-spacing 1px,
  42px height, 112px width, centered text
- Next hover: bg #3b87d9
- Previous: outline button — border 1px solid #3377c0, color #3377c0,
  transparent bg
- Previous hover: same as Next (filled blue)
- Validation text when disabled: "You must fill all fields, to be able to continue"
- Previous hidden on step 1

## Responsive behavior (< 768px)
- Background image removed
- Card: auto width, padding 60px 20px 20px
- Form fields: single column
- Grid items: 2 columns (47% width), labels horizontal (not vertical)
- Navigation buttons: stacked vertically, right-aligned
